notes:
Original source has a terminal acquisition miss in the shared cache; no original statistics were taken from Song’s reproduced F&K columns. No target-coefficient test statistic is printed: the table prints regression coefficients and Newey–West standard errors, so the printed coefficient is retained without conversion. The J-test chi-square and p concern instrument validity and are not the target test. P is the printed star-defined significance threshold, not an exact p-value. The paper provides an overall confirmation verdict but no separate narrative success verdict for this lagged-merit/interest-rate test; target-specific reported_success is left null.
Source follow-up: Published article title and DOI match assigned original reference. Requested individual test statistic is not printed: Table 5 reports coefficients and Newey–West standard errors, not individual t/z statistics. Preserved the printed coefficient without calculating coefficient/SE. Standard error for this coefficient is 0.146. Joint EXCLM/EXCLG Wald tests and Hansen J tests are different tests and were not substituted. p is the upper significance threshold indicated by the printed star legend, not an exact p-value. The n value records the explicitly identified 12-country analysis panel, not an inferred country-year observation count. Replication and narrative success were not examined, as this is original-only validation.
